recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is indicated for FHIR-14838 unless PA later decides to revisit canonical DEA identifier-system guidance as a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14838 requested NPI and DEA number fields for Practitioner. It was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: these identifiers are US realm content already covered by US Core, and the accepted core action was to update one existing example to include the identifiers without adding base-spec narrative or guidance.
initial_application: Git commit 7984cef243659d52279efd9e6f8f477fce72bcf1 applied the issue by adding SSN, NPI, and DEA identifiers to source/practitioner/practitioner-examples-general.xml. Later commit d1f387ce5e71114e7369ac9dd345022ded36edd0 updated v2/v3 terminology URLs while preserving the NPI and DEA identifiers.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Practitioner active, and source/practitioner/list-Practitioner-examples.xml lists practitioner-examples-general in the built Practitioner examples. The Jira-linked Patient Administration Zulip thread supports representing DEA/NPI in Practitioner.identifier, possibly PractitionerRole.identifier, and treating them as US-realm/US Core content rather than adding new base fields. Corrected FHIR-14838 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting follow-up evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/practitioner/practitioner-examples-general.xml already includes an NPI identifier using http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi and a DEA identifier in the Practitioner/1 example, satisfying the final resolution.
